CA.name: Blue vervain
CA.citation: Native range confirmed across Canadian provinces NB/NS/ON/QC (NC Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox). Deliberately distinguished from the European Verbena officinalis, a separate species with its own naming history

DE.name: Blaues Eisenkraut
DE.citation: Gartenblues; Yarinde nursery. Also documented as Lanzen-Eisenkraut (Gaissmayer, Promesse de Fleurs). Multiple German sources explicitly distinguish this North American species from the native/naturalized Verbena officinalis

GB.name: American blue vervain
GB.citation: Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) plant record; 'American' explicitly used to disambiguate from the native British Verbena officinalis. Also listed as American simpler's joy, ironweed, wild hyssop

US.name: Blue vervain
US.citation: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder; NC Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox. Also documented as swamp vervain, swamp verbena, simpler's joy, American vervain
